# Lantern Sync 3.8.0

## What changed

Lantern Sync 3.8.0 makes large uploads faster and changes what happens when two devices edit the same file.

- **Faster uploads:** Uploads of files over 1 GiB are up to 40% faster. The default chunk size grows from 8 MiB to 16 MiB.
